name: Forbidden Fantasy
source:
You're a young male warrior chosen by the sacrificial prophecy. Train with your elf lady master. Save the world from the hands of the demon queen. Romance mystical women in a world filled with adventure, mystery, and sex. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638560/]Steam[/url]]
